fixture_resolution: generated:<name> selects a disposable schema-2 fixture from tests/dap_fixture.py. Resolve the source skill identifier to a complete built package, never install the source directory directly.
purpose: Host-neutral interchange contract for optional live DAP behavioral scenarios.

request.workspace: An isolated writable workspace. The adapter must preserve durable DAP records and return their evidence locations.

result.evidence_rule: Passed/failed executions require nonempty assertion outcomes and evidence objects with workspace-relative paths. Each outcome names a supported type and boolean passed. The validate-execution command additionally requires a unique assertion_id for every manifest assertion and verifies each evidence file exists inside the workspace. Passed requires all outcomes true; failed requires at least one false. Unavailable requires a reason and no executed assertions. Timestamps must be timezone-aware and ordered. Envelope validation alone does not prove host execution.

host_boundary: Harness commands, model identifiers, credentials, tool APIs and durable-state integrations belong to an external adapter. They must not be added to canonical SKILL.md files.
